summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mark Gertler, an American economist born March 31, 1951. It identifies him as the Henry and Lucy Moses Professor of Economics at New York University and a specialist in business cycles and monetary policy. It also notes his long association with Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke and his status as one of the world's most cited economists.
one_line: Biographical entry on Mark Gertler, NYU economist specializing in business cycles and monetary policy, longtime collaborator of Ben Bernanke.
key_facts: Mark Lionel Gertler was born on March 31, 1951.
Mark Gertler is an American economist.
Mark Gertler holds the title Henry and Lucy Moses Professor of Economics at New York University.
Mark Gertler is a specialist in business cycles and monetary policy.
Mark Gertler has been an associate and collaborator of Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke for more than 30 years.
Mark Gertler is among the 20 most cited economists in the world.
